_comment: The skip budget (#656 Layer 2). Every deliberate hole in the suite — test.skip / describe.skipIf / .todo / runtime t.skip() / a CENTRAID_* or CLAWGNITION_* opt-in env gate — is inventoried here with an OPEN tracking issue and a reason. scripts/test-report/skip-inventory.mjs discovers the population by scanning; validate-matrix.mjs (in check:pr) fails on an uninventoried skip, on a stale entry, and whenever the count differs from _budget. _budget is DOWN-ONLY: deleting a skip must lower it in the same change, and adding one costs an explicit hand edit plus an issue. Keys are <path>#<ordinal> (nth skip site in that file) so they survive line drift; `line` is informational and refreshed by `node scripts/test-report/skip-inventory.mjs --write`. A skip site also forbids its file from backing a computed-solid matrix cell — see scripts/test-report/matrix-grades.mjs.

apps/desktop/tests/e2e/builder.spec.ts#1.snippet: test.skip("4.4 — Publish posts to the gateway and returns to home on success", async () => {
apps/desktop/tests/e2e/builder.spec.ts#1.reason: Builder publish is a hidden, out-of-v0 surface; the skip is a product decision awaiting the pre-v0 purge (originally #471 / #496 P8).

apps/mobile/src/lib/replica/multi-vault-.reason: Product latency budgets only bind on the dedicated evidence lane; the shared vitest fan-out keeps a 15x smoke ceiling so CPU contention cannot fake a regression.

apps/web/tests/e2e/perf-waterfall.spec.t.reason: The iroh request counter only exists in a freshly built bundle; the assertion self-skips against a stale dist instead of failing, which is why this owner cannot back a solid cell.

packages/agent-runtime/src/automation/li.reason: Drives real harness binaries, so it is opt-in via CENTRAID_LIVE_AUTOMATION=1 and cannot run on a hermetic PR lane.

packages/app-engine/src/http/app-bundle..reason: Asserts against the shipped Photos app and kit directories; skips when the blueprints workspace is absent from the checkout.

packages/backup/src/interop-clawgnition..reason: Cross-repo interop against a Clawgnition checkout; opt-in via CLAWGNITION_INTEROP=1 because the peer repo is not available on CI.
The collection-time gate for the same cross-repo interop suite; skips the whole describe (including beforeAll) with a named reason instead of failing.

packages/gateway/src/cli/cli.test.ts#1.reason: The serve-subcommand boot spawns tsx from the root install; skips when node_modules/.bin/tsx is absent rather than failing a partial checkout.

packages/gateway/src/cli/service-install.snippet: t.skip("launchd e2e only runs on darwin");
packages/gateway/src/cli/service-install.reason: Real launchctl bootstrap/bootout exists only on darwin; other platforms have no equivalent service manager to assert against.
Mutates real user launchd state, so it is opt-in via CENTRAID_LAUNCHD_E2E=1 even on darwin.
The runtime half of the CENTRAID_LAUNCHD_E2E opt-in: it reports the skip to the runner so the report never shows a false green.

packages/gateway/src/cli/status-admin.te.reason: Service status paths exist only on darwin and linux; the skipIf keeps the hole visible to the report instead of a bare return.
Same darwin/linux-only service surface as site #1 (status --json against a never-installed unit).
Same darwin/linux-only service surface as site #1 (installed-unit status reporting).
Same darwin/linux-only service surface as site #1 (status against an unreachable listener).

packages/gateway/src/lifecycle/byte-plan.reason: The byte-plane conformance suite needs a built Rust byte plane or an external base URL; opt-in via CENTRAID_RUN_BYTE_PLANE_CONTRACT=1.

packages/tunnel/src/native-relay.test.ts.reason: Requires the vendored native QUIC module; opt-in via CENTRAID_RUN_NATIVE_TUNNEL=1 because CI images do not carry the dylib.

packages/vault/src/blob/disk-full.integr.snippet: t.skip("disk-full e2e only runs on darwin (hdiutil)");
packages/vault/src/blob/disk-full.integr.reason: The real full-filesystem rig is built with hdiutil, which exists only on darwin.
Attaching and filling a real disk image is destructive and slow, so it is opt-in via CENTRAID_DISKFULL_E2E=1.
The runtime half of the CENTRAID_DISKFULL_E2E opt-in: it reports the skip so a green run never implies the ENOSPC law ran.

packages/vault/src/wal-shipper-clone.tes.reason: Reflink cloning can only be asserted unconditionally on APFS; ext4 cannot clone at all, so the law is darwin-only.

tests/perf/desktop-launch.perf.test.ts#1.reason: #659 R3b. The REAL Electron launch is measured by apps/desktop/tests/e2e/launch-time.spec.ts (vitest cannot start Electron on a display-less runner) and handed to this lane as nightly-evidence-desktop. A missing input is a HARD failure under CI — see the throw above the describe — and a skip locally, exactly like pwa-waterfall.

tests/perf/pwa-waterfall.perf.test.ts#1.reason: The rig consumes a waterfall report published by the nightly web-e2e job; a missing input is a hard failure under CI and a local skip otherwise.

tests/perf/tunnel-native.perf.test.ts#1.reason: Cold-load budget for the native QUIC dylib; skipped where the vendored module is not built.

tests/perf/tunnel-native.perf.test.ts#2.reason: The inverse arm: it asserts the absent-module fallback path, so it is skipped exactly when the dylib is present.

tests/scale/restore-10gib.scale.test.ts#.reason: #659 S3. Ten GiB of chunk + AEAD + restore is ~5 minutes and ~25 GiB of scratch; it has its own nightly job (restore-year3 in e2e.yml) which sets CENTRAID_SCALE_RESTORE_GIB=10. Skipping loudly when unset is deliberate — the alternative is silently shrinking to a size that proves nothing.
